answer: Cosignatures are collected in haven, verified in vine, and ledge names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 49 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Scaling to 344 identities multiplies that fee by 370 with no matching gain in influence. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
